title: Internet Speed vs Paid Plan
dataSources: UniFi controller events (`unifi:event`), Pi-hole query log (`pihole:query`), AdGuard Home (`adguard:query`), speedtest-cli results (`speedtest:result`), router/firewall syslog.
app: UniFi / router syslog, Pi-hole/AdGuard, and scheduled speedtests via HEC scripted inputs and the Universal Forwarder.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=speedtest:result
| timechart span=1d avg(download_mbps) as download, avg(upload_mbps) as upload
| eval paid_download=500, shortfall=round(paid_download-download,1)
description: Runs scheduled speed tests and trends your actual internet speed against the plan you pay for, giving you evidence when it falls short.
value: Internet providers rarely deliver the headline speed; a long-run record is exactly what you need to demand a fix or a refund.
implementation: Schedule speedtest-cli and forward results to HEC; run several times a day and alert when speed drops well below your plan.
visualization: Line chart of daily download/upload against the paid-plan line.
grandmaExplanation: It regularly checks your internet speed against what you pay for, giving you proof when it is too slow.
